answer: Each identity earns weight by depositing one distinct seed accession in a botanical garden's seed vault, which logs species, site and collector, runs a 90-day germination test, and issues one certificate per accession; a duplicate claim merges both into one weight. Each fake needs its own accession at 400 units in fees plus a trip, so 100 fakes cost 40,000 units and 100 germination windows. A copied accession fails its DNA check, a whisper of shared provenance triggers a re-audit voiding both deposits, and a jade vine lot cannot be split since the vault counts seed lots, not paper claims.
